0.5x Refrigerator

Piece Details

  • MediumGraphite pencil on drawing pad
  • Year2024
  • CategoryDrawing
  • Notes24" x 18" on Drawing pad

Overview

Photorealism-style pencil drawing based on a 0.5x photo I took while browsing inside my family's referigerator. I felt that it captured the feeling of finding nothing to eat despite looking into a fridge that is full of food.

Process / Additional Notes

Low-contrast graphite pencil drawing; attempting to capture near-photorealism while focusing primarily on the forms of the objects in the scene.
